verdict.rationale: Square documents an official Mobile Payments SDK with platform-specific iOS and Android sections. The iOS docs cover Tap to Pay on iPhone and the Android docs cover offline payments, which shows first-party SDKs for embedding in-person payments in your own mobile apps. Missing for 10: substantive SDK content beyond page titles (integration steps, reader/hardware pairing, supported features), and independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the SDK.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed in-person payments into my own iOS or Android app with official mobile SDKs

citations.quote: Accept contactless cards, Apple Pay, and other digital wallets in person with Tap to Pay on iPhone.
